newsitem.title: USA: Schroder buyback attracts 67 pct of shares.
newsitem.headline: Schroder buyback attracts 67 pct of shares.

text.p: Schroder Asian Growth Fund Inc said Friday that 13.3 million of its shares, or about 67 percent of the total outstanding, were tendered under its offer to buy back 3.5 million.
The fund said the pro-ration factor for the buyback would be about 26 percent.
Shares will be purchased for cash at net asset value (NAV) determined at the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange today, the fund said.
The NAV will be released March 24 by the opening of the market, it said.
The fund said it expects proceeds will be paid out on or about March 31.

Separately, the fund said its board met today to review the preliminary results of the tender offer and to evaluate its success in reducing or eliminating the market price discount at which the shares of the fund were trading.

"After due consideration, and consistent with its obligations set forth in the fund's prospectus, the board of directors of the fund determined that it would be appropriate to take steps to give stockholders the opportunity to vote on possible alternatives to annual tender offers as a means of addressing the market price discount, including the option of converting to open-end status," the fund said.
It said its board expects to call a special meeting of stockholders, to be held early in the third quarter, for the purpose of shareholder input.
